intro.name: Raphael El Mouallem
intro.title: Software Engineer · Full Stack & AI Developer

about.bio: I'm a software engineer based in Lebanon, currently finishing a Master's in Web Development. I build across the whole stack, from React frontends and Spring Boot backends to PyTorch models I train from scratch. Mostly I gravitate toward problems where systems, AI, and design all have to come together.
about.title: About This Site
about.description: A lightweight Japandi-style portfolio: paper textures, ink-toned colors, procedural SVG motifs. Plain React, no 3D. Framer Motion handles transitions, plus a custom cursor and generative wind-streak art.

projects.title: Nexus
projects.subtitle: Enterprise RAG Knowledge System
projects.description: A RAG platform for AI-powered search across document repositories. It combines semantic vector search with lexical search, running inference locally via Ollama or in the cloud via Gemini. Cross-platform: Angular web, Flutter mobile, containerized with Docker.

projects.title: Custom GPT-2 mini
projects.subtitle: LLM from scratch in PyTorch
projects.description: Decoder-based LLM built from scratch: 12 self-attention heads, RoPE positional encoding. Optimized for Apple MPS with matrix fusion and bfloat16, trained incrementally from 6 to 8 to 12 heads. Fine-tuned on dialog data, quantized (PQT) for inference.

projects.title: E-Commerce
projects.subtitle: Full Stack Web App
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce: React + Tailwind frontend, Spring Boot backend with auth and clean architecture, PostgreSQL/Flyway storage. User profiles, product ratings.

projects.title: Fitness App
projects.subtitle: Cross-Platform Mobile App
projects.description: Cross-platform fitness app in Flutter, web compatible. Multi-user support, anonymous mode, and TTS workout guidance, backed by encrypted SQLite storage. Separate pages for workouts, nutrition, and stats.

projects.title: Finance Tracker
projects.subtitle: Budget & Expense Manager
projects.description: A responsive Angular app for tracking expenses and categorizing budgets, with statistical dashboards and .xlsx transaction import. Django MVC backend, PostgreSQL storage.
